Under explicit experimental opt-in: Physical preorder controls with an explicit finite maxdepth proving every pathname fits PATH_MAX run in a persistent GNU depth-zero FIFO/PTY evaluator before any descendant listing. GNU truth, implicit print and output bytes remain authoritative; only directories actually visited use immediate fd listing. Root prune/quit require zero fd calls and receive no fd acceleration credit. Unsafe traversal/action/context mixtures and unavailable helper dependencies retain original GNU before evaluation starts.

output.scope: Buffered listing/evaluation modes only; incremental GNU public output is inherited and streamed.

accessTime.accelerated: regular-file-only buffered output proof, or incremental current-node evaluation before directory opening
accessTime.native: directory/symlink observations or mutable access-time references in buffered traversal; unsafe incremental traversal/action combinations

qualified: finite-depth physical preorder prune/quit with noncontextual pure output
nativeObserved: logical cross-filesystem directory boundary in buffered logical traversal

traversal.incrementalFaultContinuation: After evaluator startup, malformed/error fd listing uses local GNU depth-one discovery without original invocation replay.

backendCoverage.backend: original GNU; no assumed universally faster class
backendCoverage.contract: Absent or nonexact experimental flag preserves original raw argv, descriptors, stdin, actions and native diagnostics before Node/fd/probes in public/private Bash. Exact1 opt-in has real fd witness; no universal speed claim.

backendCoverage.backend: fd plus byte-preserving pure evaluator or GNU evaluator

backendCoverage.feature: GNU size, permissions, ownership, inode, link, emptiness, access, time and reference predicates
backendCoverage.backend: fd traversal plus nonrecursive GNU predicate broker

backendCoverage.backend: fd traversal plus nonrecursive GNU formatting broker

backendCoverage.backend: fd traversal plus GNU-order reconstruction and candidate evaluation

backendCoverage.feature: directory access time and observed logical cross-filesystem boundary
backendCoverage.backend: original GNU for proven compatibility boundary

backendCoverage.feature: deletion, external/file actions and stdin root lists
backendCoverage.backend: original GNU while dedicated semantics remain unimplemented

backendCoverage.feature: Leading root delimiter, numeric optimization and default readdir-race spelling
backendCoverage.backend: Actual fd enumeration plus nonrecursive GNU validation/evaluation
backendCoverage.contract: Leading --, zero-padded -O and noignore_readdir_race retain GNU parsing and diagnostics; late/invalid flags and action mixtures remain explicitly native.

backendCoverage.feature: Caller auxiliary and closed standard descriptors
backendCoverage.contract: Public/private calls preserve FD3/FD63/FD4097 across exec, samefile references and process substitution; evaluator chooses an unused input slot. Direct runFind can explicitly declare callerDescriptors:[3]. Closed standard0/1/2 retain GNU status/streams through direct executables.

backendCoverage.feature: finite-depth physical preorder prune/quit and short-circuit control truth
backendCoverage.backend: persistent GNU candidate evaluator plus immediate fd directory listing after evaluation
backendCoverage.contract: Root controls and file roots use GNU only; real fd contribution, validation calls, local GNU discovery and original fallback are counted separately. Fault continuation never replays prior output or actions. Unbounded or excessive-depth controls remain original GNU before helper startup; no full-expression replay can occur after output.

executionPolicy.default: original GNU find before Node, fd and expression preflight in public/private Bash routes
